residualRisks.description: The tracked dashboard has zero current inputs and seven inputs requiring attention; AM-005 must refresh it without weakening freshness rules.

The accepted-baseline JSON still labels the historical 269,482-byte GC capture red while the closeout authority records a 292-byte pass; AM-004/AM-005 must reconcile status and provenance while preserving the 1,024-byte budget.

Reviewed baseline 1a0f1eceb2d6c04359e2f868ddd9f99d26a0e713 postdates closeout measurements and changes Editor frame pacing; AM-001 did not recapture compiler, architecture, behavior, Editor performance, or GC evidence at this commit.
Sustained 30 FPS release acceptance and the separate 60 FPS high-end observation are not certified.
Installed size and absolute peak texture, mesh, audio, graphics-driver, and total memory budgets remain measurement-required.
The complete graphics-tier, Day/Night, static-map, and mip-streaming visual matrix is unaccepted, including two known visual findings.
Mip streaming remains fail closed and unauthorized pending visual, memory, and I/O evidence.
Six generated animation textures retain CPU-copy and residency risk; precision and unload safety are unproven.
Candidate-unused packages remain installed because no isolated removal slice has passed import, compile, test, build, and device validation.
Current-map CPU/GPU mesh memory and normalized canonical/chunked/GPU Resident Drawer comparisons remain uncertified.

entryDecision.rationale: The prerequisite tracker is closed with 107/107 explicit dispositions and all five core entry gate groups accepted at its early-development closeout. The 15 unpassed release-only obligations remain explicit and fail closed, so they do not block Core Architecture Lane entry and do block any release-certification claim.
